title: Orphan App_Plugins folders
description: An App_Plugins folder that matches no package reference and that no other detector explains: it holds no manifest of either generation, or only a manifest that declares nothing the registry recognizes. Often left over from a removed or renamed package; it can also be an extension the user must classify.

impact.summary: Leftover folders do nothing but can be mistaken for live extensions.

handling.option: Remove only after the user confirms the folder is unused

checks.text: The user confirmed each folder as unused before removal, with the approval recorded
